GE Stock Technicals Show Short-Term Weakness
GE shares are trading 2.4% below their 20-day simple moving average and 8% below the 50-day average, signaling weaker short-term momentum.
The 20-day average has fallen below the 50-day average, while the 50-day remains above the 200-day average following a June golden cross.
Momentum indicators are somewhat more constructive. MACD remains above its signal line with a positive histogram, suggesting downside momentum has eased.
